info.title: File organization in the data folder
info.subtitle: How to place your scans and transcriptions so the application detects them, and how processing works.
info.whereText: Everything goes under data/collections/. One folder per collection, containing a scans/ subfolder (and, after OCR, ocr/). Each registre is a folder inside scans/.
info.treeBlock:
data/collections/
└── my-collection/                     ← one folder = one collection
    ├── metadata.json                  ← type, title, period, place (auto on scan)
    ├── scans/
    │   └── my-register/               ← one folder = one registre
    │       ├── metadata.json          ← title, period, pagination (auto on scan)
    │       ├── my-register_1.jpg      ← _1 = page 1 (number after the last _)
    │       ├── my-register_2.jpg      ← _2 = page 2
    │       └── my-register_2_1.jpg    ← insert after page 2 (suffix _1)
    └── ocr/
        └── my-register/
            └── my-model/              ← one subfolder per OCR model
                └── my-register_1.xml  ← PAGE-XML, same base name as the scan
info.namingItem1: The images of a registre follow a prefix + number + extension pattern, e.g. my-register_1.jpg, my-register_2.jpg… The pattern and the bounds (first / last page) are detected automatically on scan, and remain editable via “Edit the registre”.
info.namingItem2: Insert pages (outside the main numbering): pattern prefix + number + _ + suffix, e.g. my-register_2_1.jpg.
info.namingItem3: OCR: one subfolder per model in ocr/[registre]/[model]/, .xml files in PAGE-XML format with the same base name as the image.
info.namingItem4: The metadata.json files are generated and completed by synchronization — no need to write them by hand.
info.rule1: The page number must be the last number in the name, right before the extension.
info.rule2: Separate it from the rest of the name with an underscore _ (e.g. my-register_1.jpg) — this separator is what groups a page and its inserts. Do not remove it.
info.rule3: All files of the same registre must share exactly the same prefix.
info.rule4: Insert page: add a suffix after the number, …_[number]_[suffix].jpg (e.g. my-register_2_1.jpg).
info.rule5: To avoid: any other number placed after the page number (outside the insert form) — it would distort pagination detection.
info.how1: Place the collection / registre folders in data/collections.
info.how2: Scan: read-only diagnosis (pages, OCR coverage, pagination, anomalies).
info.how3: Synchronize: creates the missing collections / registres and updates the metadata.json files.
info.how4: Run OCR on a registre with a Kraken model.
info.how5: Generate the index (full text), then search the corpus.
info.anomalyItem1: Empty registre — no image in the registre folder.
info.anomalyItem2: Undetectable pagination — cannot infer a pattern from the file names.
info.anomalyItem3: Unreadable metadata.json — corrupted or malformed metadata file.
info.anomalyItem4: Missing from disk — registre listed in the metadata but not found on disk.
info.anomalyItem5: Orphan OCR — OCR folder without a matching scans folder.
info.anomalyItem6: Outside scans/ — images are placed outside the scans/ subfolder.
